words.definition: A word you use to agree or accept.
words.example: Yes, I'd love to.

words.definition: A word you use to disagree or refuse.
words.example: No, thank you.

words.definition: A word you use to agree or show you understand.
words.example: Okay, see you at six.

words.definition: A short way to say goodbye.
words.example: Bye! Have a nice weekend.

words.definition: Good, healthy, or acceptable.
words.example: I'm fine, thanks.

words.definition: In a good way.
words.example: You speak English very well.

words.definition: A sound you make when you are surprised or did not hear something.
words.example: Huh? Can you repeat that?

words.definition: A sound you make when you are thinking.
words.example: Hmm, let me think about it.

words.definition: A sound you make when you are hesitating.
words.example: Uh, I'm not sure.

words.definition: Fine or acceptable, or used to agree.
words.example: Alright, let's go.

words.definition: The number 11.
words.example: The shop opens at eleven.

words.definition: The number 12.
words.example: There are twelve months in a year.

words.definition: The number 13.
words.example: She's thirteen years old.

words.definition: The number 14.
words.example: I'll be there in fourteen minutes.

words.definition: The number 15.
words.example: The meeting lasts fifteen minutes.

words.definition: The number 16.
words.example: You can drive at sixteen.

words.definition: The number 17.
words.example: My cousin is seventeen.

words.definition: The number 18.
words.example: You can vote at eighteen.

words.definition: The number 19.
words.example: There were nineteen people in the class.

words.definition: The number 20.
words.example: The ticket costs twenty dollars.

words.definition: A period of twenty-four hours, or the time when it is light.
words.example: Have a nice day!

words.definition: What clocks measure, or an occasion.
words.example: What time is it?

words.definition: The period between birth and death.
words.example: Life is busy here.

words.definition: The earth and all its people.
words.example: She wants to travel around the world.

words.definition: The place where you live.
words.example: I'm going home now.

words.definition: A building where people live.
words.example: They bought a big house by the river.

words.definition: A part of a building with walls, or space for something.
words.example: There's no room in the car.

words.definition: What people and animals eat.
words.example: The food here is great.

words.definition: A nation, or the land outside cities.
words.example: Which country are you from?

words.definition: A unit of language with a meaning.
words.example: I don't know this word.

words.definition: To move something so that it is not closed, or to start business for the day.
words.example: What time does the bank open?

words.definition: To shut something.
words.example: Close your eyes and make a wish.

words.definition: To hold something and take it from one place to another.
words.example: Let me carry that bag for you.

words.definition: To press something so that it moves away from you.
words.example: Push the button once and wait.

words.definition: To hold something and move it toward you.
words.example: The sign says pull, not push.

words.definition: To clean something with water and soap.
words.example: I need to wash my hands before eating.

words.definition: To prepare food by heating it.
words.example: I love to cook on Sundays.

words.definition: To remove dirt from something.
words.example: We clean the house every Saturday.

words.definition: To rest with your eyes closed and your mind switched off.
words.example: Did you sleep well last night?

words.definition: To pay attention to a sound or to what someone says.
words.example: Listen, I have something to tell you.

words.definition: Large in size.
words.example: That's a big dog!

words.definition: Not large in size.
words.example: We live in a small town.

words.definition: Made or bought recently.
words.example: Do you like my new phone?

words.definition: Having existed for a long time.
words.example: This old jacket is still warm.

words.definition: Having a high temperature.
words.example: It's so hot today.

words.definition: Having a low temperature.
words.example: Your hands are cold!

words.definition: Not costing much money.
words.example: These shoes were really cheap.

words.definition: Weighing a lot.
words.example: This box is too heavy for me.

words.definition: Not hard to do or understand.
words.example: Don't worry, this recipe is really easy.

words.definition: Hard to do or understand.
words.example: English spelling can be difficult.

words.definition: To move or travel from one place to another.
words.example: Where do you want to go for dinner?

words.definition: To move toward the speaker or arrive at a place.
words.example: Can you come to my house on Friday?

words.definition: To put food in your mouth and swallow it.
words.example: Let's eat outside tonight.

words.definition: To take liquid into your mouth and swallow it.
words.example: I'm trying to drink more water.

words.definition: To get something by paying money for it.
words.example: I need to buy a gift for my mom.

words.definition: To hand something to someone so that they have it.
words.example: Give me a call when you get there.

words.definition: To get something and move it with you.
words.example: Take the first left and keep going.

words.definition: To carry something with you to a place.
words.example: Please bring your ID to the interview.

words.definition: To discover something you were looking for.
words.example: I can't find my phone.

words.definition: To require something because it is important.
words.example: Do you need any help?

words.definition: A piece of clothing for the upper body, usually with a collar and buttons.
words.example: I spilled coffee on my white shirt.

words.definition: Clothing that covers your legs and body from the waist down.
words.example: These pants are a little too long.

words.definition: Things you wear on your feet when you go outside.
words.example: Take off your shoes at the door.

words.definition: A short coat.
words.example: Bring a jacket. It gets cold at night.

words.definition: Something you wear on your head.
words.example: He always wears a hat in the sun.

words.definition: Soft coverings you wear on your feet inside your shoes.
words.example: I can't find a matching pair of socks.

words.definition: A piece of clothing that hangs from the waist and has no legs.
words.example: She wore a long blue skirt to the party.

words.definition: Two lenses in a frame that you wear to see better.
words.example: Have you seen my glasses?

words.definition: A small bag sewn into clothes where you keep small things.
words.example: My phone is in my back pocket.

words.definition: To have clothes or accessories on your body.
words.example: What are you going to wear tonight?

words.definition: The top part of your body, with your face and brain.
words.example: Watch your head! The ceiling is low.

words.definition: The part at the end of your arm, with fingers.
words.example: Raise your hand if you know the answer.

words.definition: The part at the end of your leg that you stand on.
words.example: I hurt my foot playing soccer.

words.definition: The part of your face that you see with.
words.example: Keep an eye on my bag, please.

words.definition: The part of your head that you hear with.
words.example: My left ear hurts.

words.definition: The part of your face you use to eat and speak.
words.example: Don't talk with your mouth full.

words.definition: The long part of your body between your shoulder and your hand.
words.example: He broke his arm skiing.

words.definition: The long part of your body that you walk on.
words.example: My legs are tired after the long walk.

words.definition: The part of your body behind your chest, from the neck down.
words.example: I have a pain in my lower back.

words.definition: The part of your face you smell with.
words.example: My nose is stuffed up.

words.definition: To move on foot at a normal speed.
words.example: We can walk to the station from here.

words.definition: To move on foot faster than walking.
words.example: I run three times a week.

words.definition: To rest with your weight on your bottom, not standing.
words.example: Please sit down. The doctor will see you soon.

words.definition: To be on your feet, not sitting.
words.example: We had to stand the whole way on the bus.

words.definition: To change direction.
words.example: Turn left at the traffic light.

words.definition: To end a movement or an action.
words.example: Stop here, please. This is my house.

words.definition: To go into a place.
words.example: You can't enter without a ticket.

words.definition: To go away from a place.
words.example: What time do you leave for work?

words.definition: To reach a place at the end of a trip.
words.example: Our train arrives at seven.

words.definition: To go behind someone and move where they go.
words.example: Follow me. I'll show you the way.

words.definition: A road vehicle with four wheels and an engine.
words.example: We're taking my car, if that's okay.

words.definition: A large vehicle that carries many people along a route.
words.example: I take the bus to work every day.

words.definition: A long vehicle that runs on rails.
words.example: The train to Boston leaves at noon.

words.definition: A two-wheeled vehicle you ride by pushing pedals.
words.example: My bike has a flat tire.

words.definition: A car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere.
words.example: It's late. Let's just take a taxi.

words.definition: A vehicle with wings that flies.
words.example: My plane lands at nine in the morning.

words.definition: A piece of paper or a code that lets you enter or travel.
words.example: How much is a ticket to the airport?

words.definition: To control a car and make it go.
words.example: Can you drive me to the station?

words.definition: A trip in a car, on a bike or on a horse.
words.example: Do you need a ride home?

words.definition: A hard path that cars and trucks drive on.
words.example: This road is closed because of the snow.
